items.title: Interpretability

summaries.zh: “可解释性”是指理解模型决策过程的能力。它有助于评估模型的有效性和可靠性，确保决策的透明度和公正性。可解释性在人工智能领域尤为重要，因为它能帮助用户信任并验证模型的输出结果。通过提高模型的可解释性，可以更好地发现潜在问题并优化性能。
summaries.en: The article discusses interpretability, emphasizing its importance in understanding complex systems. It highlights methods to enhance transparency and explainability, such as visualizations and simplified models. Interpretability is crucial for building trust, improving reliability, and ensuring ethical use in fields like AI and data science. The piece underscores its role in debugging, validation, and decision-making processes. While not specifying a particular context, the article stresses interpretability as a key factor in effective problem-solving and system design.
